about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Nam Jim Seafood Chilli Lime Sauce
recipes.summary: A sharp, garlicky green chilli and lime sauce that wakes up steamed fish and prawns.
steps: Blend the chillies, garlic and coriander with the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and water until a loose, slightly chunky sauce forms.
Taste and add sugar if too sharp or lime if too flat.
Spoon over hot steamed fish or prawns just before serving.
notes: Wear gloves when cutting the chillies, or wash your hands well afterwards.
Use within 3 days; the colour fades as it sits.

recipes.title: Balkan Ajvar Roasted Capsicum Spread
recipes.summary: A smoky roasted capsicum and eggplant relish eaten on bread or with grilled meat.
steps: Roast the whole capsicums and eggplant at 220°C for 45 minutes, turning once, until blackened and collapsing.
Cover the vegetables in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel off the skins and remove the seeds and stalks.
Blend the flesh with the garlic, vinegar, salt and sugar, then cook in a saucepan with the oil over low heat for 10 minutes until thick.
notes: Stir often so it does not catch on the base.
Keeps for 1 week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Canarian Mojo Rojo Red Sauce
recipes.summary: A garlicky red pepper sauce from the Canary Islands, served with potatoes and grilled meat.
steps: Soak the chillies in hot water for 10 minutes until soft, then drain and discard the stalks.
Blend the chillies, paprika, garlic, cumin and salt to a paste.
Add the vinegar and water, then blend while slowly pouring in the oil until thick and glossy.
notes: Classic with salt-crusted baby potatoes.
Keeps for 1 week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Portuguese Piri Piri Sauce
recipes.summary: A hot lemon and garlic chilli sauce for basting chicken or dipping chips.
steps: Blend the chillies, garlic, paprika, oregano and salt with the lemon juice and vinegar until fairly smooth.
Pour into a saucepan with the oil and simmer over low heat for 8 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened and the raw edge is gone.
Cool, taste and adjust the salt and acid.
notes: Brush on at the end of cooking so the sugars do not burn.
Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Argentine Red Chimichurri
recipes.summary: A red version of chimichurri with capsicum and chilli, built for grilled steak.

items: 1 roasted red capsicum, from a jar, drained

steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic by hand or in short pulses.
Blend or chop the capsicum into small pieces and stir it in with the oregano, chilli flakes and salt.
Stir in the oil and vinegar until combined, then leave for 15 minutes so the flavours soften.
notes: Keep it chunky, not puréed.
Use within 5 days.

recipes.title: Peruvian-Style Yellow Chilli Cream Sauce
recipes.summary: A creamy, mild yellow chilli sauce in the style of Peruvian huancaina, for potatoes and eggs.
steps: Blend the capsicum, chilli, feta, milk, crackers, turmeric and lime juice until smooth.
Pour in the oil slowly while blending until the sauce is thick and creamy.
Taste and adjust with lime or a pinch of salt, then chill before serving.
notes: Feta is salty, so check before adding any extra salt.
Use within 3 days.

recipes.title: Sweet Tomato Chutney for Snacks
recipes.summary: A sticky tomato chutney with cumin and ginger for dosa, fritters and cheese toasties.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add the cumin seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they sizzle.
Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the ginger, garlic, chilli and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, vinegar and salt, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and jammy.
notes: Cool before spooning into a clean jar.
Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Homemade Japanese Ponzu Sauce
recipes.summary: A citrus-soy sauce for dumplings, grilled fish and cold noodles.
steps: Combine the lemon juice, lime juice, soy sauce, mirin, vinegar and sugar in a jar.
Add the water and shake until the sugar dissolves.
Taste and add a little more citrus or soy as you prefer.
notes: Leave overnight in the fridge for a rounder flavour if you have time.
Keeps for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Sichuan Chilli Oil Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A numbing, fragrant chilli oil for dumplings, noodles and cold dishes.
steps: Put the chilli flakes, sesame seeds, sugar and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil with the peppercorns, garlic and star anise over low heat for 6 minutes until the garlic is just golden, then strain the hot oil over the chilli flakes, discarding the solids.
Let it sizzle, cool for 10 minutes, then stir in the soy sauce.
notes: Do not let the oil smoke or the chilli will taste bitter.
Keeps for 3 weeks in the fridge.

recipes.title: Lebanese Garlic Yoghurt Sauce
recipes.summary: A creamy garlic and lemon yoghurt sauce for shawarma, kebabs and roast vegetables.
steps: Crush the garlic with the salt into a paste.
Mix with the yoghurt and lemon juice until smooth.
Stir through the oil and mint and leave for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Use less garlic for a gentler sauce.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Quick Tomato Sambal
recipes.summary: A cooked tomato and chilli sambal that comes together in minutes for rice and fried eggs.
steps: Blend the chillies, shallots and garlic into a coarse paste.
Fry the paste in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until fragrant and the oil separates.
Add the tomatoes, sugar and salt and cook for 6 minutes until pulpy and thick, then stir in the lime juice.
notes: Add more chilli for heat, or deseed some for a milder sauce.
Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Chilli Drizzle
recipes.summary: A sweet, hot chilli honey for pizza, fried chicken, cheese boards and roast vegetables.
steps: Warm the honey with the chilli flakes in a small saucepan over low heat for 5 minutes until runny and gently simmering.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vinegar and salt.
Cool for 20 minutes, then pour into a clean jar.
notes: Strain out the flakes for a smoother drizzle.
Keep at room temperature for a month.
